key_insight: Reinforcement learning guides adaptive grid refinement for the Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman equation, targeting higher node density where discretization error is large.
engineering_relevance: Error-focused refinement could make optimal feedback control computation more resource-efficient than fixed-grid approaches.
method: Solve the HJB PDE on a state-space grid.
Use reinforcement learning to guide dynamic grid refinement.
Concentrate nodes in high-error regions while seeking to reduce total node count.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes the approach and intended benefits but reports no benchmarks, quantitative accuracy gains, or node-count reductions.
watch_item: Scalability to high-dimensional state spaces and the computational overhead of RL-guided refinement require validation.
paper_title: Adaptive Grid Refinement for Optimal Feedback Control
